Players Committee card image of [[Captain Peavey (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -1 to Finalizer. While piloting Finalizer, it is immune to attrition <8 (< 10 while with a Resistance character or [Resistance] starship). May be targeted by Imperial Command as an admiral (even if a unit of Force).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/captainpeavey.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 6489b69] (10 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
